preconditions.expression: n == int(stdin.split()[0]) and n >= 1 and n <= 2 * 10**5
preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 2·10^5) representing the number of gifts.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.split()[1:]) == n and all(-10**9 <= int(a) <= 10**9 for a in stdin.split()[1:])
preconditions.description: The second line contains exactly n integers a₁, a₂, ..., aₙ (each between -10^9 and 10^9) representing the pleasantness of each gift.

preconditions.expression: len(stdin.splitlines()) == n and all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: The next (n - 1) lines each contain two integers uᵢ, vᵢ (1 ≤ uᵢ, vᵢ ≤ n, uᵢ ≠ vᵢ) representing undirected edges of the tree.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(u) <= n and 1 <= int(v) <= n and int(u) != int(v) for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] for u, v in [line.split()])
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two distinct gifts, and all gifts are connected in a tree rooted at gift 1.
Gift 1 is the root of the tree (either explicitly or implicitly by connectivity).

postconditions.description: If no two disjoint subtrees exist, output 'Impossible'. Otherwise, output the maximum possible sum of pleasantness of two disjoint subtrees rooted at any two distinct gifts.

postconditions.expression: max_sum == max(sum_subtree(a, root1) + sum_subtree(a, root2) for root1 in range(1, n+1) for root2 in range(1, n+1) if root1 != root2 and not any(ancestor_in_subtree(root1, x) and ancestor_in_subtree(root2, x) for x in range(1, n+1))) if any(root1 != root2 and not any(ancestor_in_subtree(root1, x) and ancestor_in_subtree(root2, x) for x in range(1, n+1)) for root1 in range(1, n+1) for root2 in range(1, n+1)) else None
postconditions.description: The output is the maximum sum of pleasantness of two disjoint subtrees (no common ancestor or descendant) rooted at any two distinct gifts. If no such pair exists, output 'Impossible'.
